calibration: Every probability names its outcome, conditioning variables, population, period and denominator.
Separate NFL recruitment weights, national or diaspora background context, phenotype observations and grooming assumptions.
Keep original overlapping responses alongside a versioned reporting projection. Undisclosed identity is missing information, not an appearance preset.
Fit compatible joint observations where available. Marginals alone do not identify a unique joint distribution; fallback priors require an explicit assumption and sensitivity comparison.
Check cohort overlap, selection, source measurement definitions and sparse cells before fitting. Hold out observations for evaluation when fitting is possible.
appearance: Persist separate natural scalp, eyebrow and beard pigment; skin shade and undertone; iris pigment and pattern; curl, thickness, density and hairline; facial dimensions and bounded asymmetry.
Resolve haircuts, fades, parts, braids, locs, length, beard styles, dye and treatment through the same natural recipe. Build coherent geometry rather than changing metadata alone.
Keep continuous variation beneath user-facing color and texture names. Model rare or unusual combinations without requiring one of every combination on every team.
Keep hairstyle inventory and frequency assumptions explicit; census categories do not supply a haircut survey.
physique: Use stature, dated mass, reach, source-defined arm length and hand measurements as hard inputs after validating their precision and endpoints.
Estimate missing torso/leg shares, breadths, depths and regional bulk jointly with a stable individual residual recipe; distinguish estimates from measurements.
Preserve original conflicting measurements, report fitting residuals and choose a documented reconciliation. Do not silently clamp measured outliers to a position average.
Condition estimates on compatible athlete measurements and training state where supported. Overall, potential or racial labels cannot substitute for composition measurements.
Drive separate speed, acceleration, cutting, jump, strength and endurance demonstrations through the resolved skeleton. Physical updates retain dated history and natural identity.

completionPolicy: Research and planned acceptance only. Require normal-size image inspection, measured-frame reconstruction, demographic calibration diagnostics and actual career/save commands before complete-player acceptance.
